remarks: Immaculate 2 bedroom house in the Cove area with walking distance to the beach, restaurants and public transportation. Freshly painted through out. Spacious living room open to the large eat in kitchen with new floors, new stainless steel gas range and refrigerator. The cabinets have been sanded and restained. There is a powder room with a new toilet and large closet. An unheated mud room or den complete the first floor. There are two large bedrooms on the second floor along with a full bath. The bath has a new vanity and toilet. A pull down attic and full basement with laundry complete this fine home. There is a 2 car garage that is available for additional 500.00
